jp: 両親は演奏家で世界各地を転々としており、まったく構ってもらえていない。それもあり、頻繁に手紙やお菓子を送ってきてくれる祖父にとても懐いている。
jp_grezzo: "両親は演奏家で世界各地を転々としており、まったく構ってもらえていない。それもあり、頻繁に手紙やお菓子を送ってきてくれる祖父にとても懐いている。"
en: His parents are performers and have moved around the world and they don't care for him at all. For that reason he is very fond of his grandfather who frequently sends him letters and sweets.
en_grezzo: "His parents are performers and have moved around the world and they don't care for him at all. For that reason he is very fond of his grandfather who frequently sends him letters and sweets."
it: I genitori fanno i musicisti e girano il mondo senza mai fermarsi, e di lui non si occupa nessuno. Anche per questo si è affezionato moltissimo al nonno, che gli manda spesso lettere e dolciumi.

jp: 年を経た蜥蜴が変異した。姿はドラゴンとよく似ているがどちらかというと神の方に近い。雷やそれに伴う轟音を操り敵を攻撃する。
jp_grezzo: "年を経た蜥蜴が変異した。姿はドラゴンとよく似ているがどちらかというと神の方に近い。雷やそれに伴う轟音を操り敵を攻撃する。"
en: An aged lizard has mutated. Its appearance is similar to that of a dragon but it is closer to that of a god. It uses lightning and its accompanying roar to attack the enemy.
en_grezzo: "An aged lizard has mutated. Its appearance is similar to that of a dragon but it is closer to that of a god. It uses lightning and its accompanying roar to attack the enemy."
it: È una lucertola che, con gli anni, è mutata. Nell'aspetto somiglia molto a un drago, ma se si deve scegliere sta più dalla parte degli dei. Attacca il nemico comandando il fulmine e il fragore che gli va dietro.

jp: 父親の跡を継ぎ道場を譲り受けた。だがやる気が空回りした結果、門下生全員に逃げられてしまう。竹刀は父から貰ったもので、失くすと途端に弱気になる。
jp_grezzo: "父親の跡を継ぎ道場を譲り受けた。だがやる気が空回りした結果、門下生全員に逃げられてしまう。竹刀は父から貰ったもので、失くすと途端に弱気になる。"
en: She took over the dojo in her father's footsteps. However as a result of her lack of motivation she is abandoned by all her students. The bamboo sword was given to her by her father and when she loses it she immediately becomes weak.
en_grezzo: "She took over the dojo in her father's footsteps. However as a result of her lack of motivation she is abandoned by all her students. The bamboo sword was given to her by her father and when she loses it she immediately becomes weak."
it: Ha preso il posto del padre e si è vista lasciare la palestra. Ma la voglia di fare le è girata a vuoto, e alla fine gli allievi sono scappati tutti quanti. La spada di bambù gliel'ha data il padre: se la perde, all'istante si perde d'animo.

jp: 募集要項をよく読まずに応募してしまった。「雨を呼ぶために滅多打ちにされるマスコットの中の人」というバイト内容だったので後悔している。
jp_grezzo: "募集要項をよく読まずに応募してしまった。「雨を呼ぶために滅多打ちにされるマスコットの中の人」というバイト内容だったので後悔している。"
en: He applied for the job without reading the job description carefully. He regret it because his part-time job description was the person in the mascot who is often beaten up to call the rain.
en_grezzo: "He applied for the job without reading the job description carefully. He regret it because his part-time job description was the person in the mascot who is often beaten up to call the rain."
it: Si è candidato senza leggere per bene l'annuncio. Adesso se ne pente: il lavoro consisteva nello stare dentro la mascotte che, per chiamare la pioggia, viene presa a bastonate.

jp: 長い間、森とそこで暮らす生き物たちを守ってきた。寿命が尽きたその時、森の生き物たちの信仰心によって、白き炎に包まれ神への転生を果たした。
jp_grezzo: "長い間、森とそこで暮らす生き物たちを守ってきた。寿命が尽きたその時、森の生き物たちの信仰心によって、白き炎に包まれ神への転生を果たした。"
en: For a long time he protected the forest and the creatures that live in it. At the end of his life he was reincarnated as a god enveloped in white fire by the faith of the creatures of the forest.
en_grezzo: "For a long time he protected the forest and the creatures that live in it. At the end of his life he was reincarnated as a god enveloped in white fire by the faith of the creatures of the forest."
it: Per lunghissimo tempo ha protetto la foresta e le creature che ci vivono. E quando la sua vita è arrivata al termine, la fede di quelle creature lo ha avvolto in una fiamma bianca e lo ha fatto rinascere dio.

jp: 遺伝子操作により生み出された人工生命体。エーテルの生成・散布器官をもち広範囲を浄化する。対メシェーラの切り札だったが量産される前にレム・イドは滅亡した。
jp_grezzo: "遺伝子操作により生み出された人工生命体。エーテルの生成・散布器官をもち広範囲を浄化する。対メシェーラの切り札だったが量産される前にレム・イドは滅亡した。"
en: Genetically engineered artificial life forms. It has an ether generation and dispersal organ and can spread to a wide range of areas. It was a trump card against Meshera but Rehmido was destroyed before it could be mass-produced.
en_grezzo: "Genetically engineered artificial life forms. It has an ether generation and dispersal organ and can spread to a wide range of areas. It was a trump card against Meshera but Rehmido was destroyed before it could be mass-produced."
it: Una forma di vita artificiale nata dalla manipolazione dei geni. Ha un organo che produce e diffonde l'etere, e purifica aree molto vaste. Era la carta vincente contro i Meshera, ma Rehm-Ido cadde prima che se ne potessero fare in quantità.

jp: レム・イド文明生き残りの子孫。普段は皆シェルターで生活しており、庭園に出るのは月に一度ほど。
jp_grezzo: "レム・イド文明生き残りの子孫。普段は皆シェルターで生活しており、庭園に出るのは月に一度ほど。"
en: The surviving descendants of the Rehmido civilization. They all live in a shelter and only go out to the garden about once a month.
en_grezzo: "The surviving descendants of the Rehmido civilization. They all live in a shelter and only go out to the garden about once a month."
it: Discende da chi sopravvisse alla civiltà di Rehm-Ido. Vivono tutti dentro il rifugio, e nel giardino escono si e no una volta al mese.

jp: レム・イド文明生き残りの子孫。メシェーラの脅威とエーテルの加護について次の世代に語り継ぐのが主な仕事。
jp_grezzo: "レム・イド文明生き残りの子孫。メシェーラの脅威とエーテルの加護について次の世代に語り継ぐのが主な仕事。"
en: The surviving descendants of the Rehmido civilization. His main job is to tell the next generation about the threat of Meshera and the blessings of the ether.
en_grezzo: "The surviving descendants of the Rehmido civilization. His main job is to tell the next generation about the threat of Meshera and the blessings of the ether."
it: Discende da chi sopravvisse alla civiltà di Rehm-Ido. Il suo compito principale è raccontare a chi verrà dopo che cosa sono la minaccia dei Meshera e la protezione dell'etere.

jp: レム・イド文明生き残りの子孫。メシェーラの脅威をよくわかっておらず、外の世界に憧れを抱いている。
jp_grezzo: "レム・イド文明生き残りの子孫。メシェーラの脅威をよくわかっておらず、外の世界に憧れを抱いている。"
en: The surviving descendants of the Rehmido civilization. He is not familiar with the threats of Meshera and has a longing for the outside world.
en_grezzo: "The surviving descendants of the Rehmido civilization. He is not familiar with the threats of Meshera and has a longing for the outside world."
it: Discende da chi sopravvisse alla civiltà di Rehm-Ido. Che cosa sia la minaccia dei Meshera non l'ha ben capito, e il mondo di fuori lo attira.

jp: 元は三匹のドラゴンだったが、元素のイツパロトルの加護を受け神化を果たした。火炎と氷という、相反する属性のブレスを融合させるだけの実力はない。
jp_grezzo: "元は三匹のドラゴンだったが、元素のイツパロトルの加護を受け神化を果たした。火炎と氷という、相反する属性のブレスを融合させるだけの実力はない。"
en: He was originally three dragons but with the blessing of the elemental Itzparotl he became a deity. It does not have the ability to merge the conflicting attributes of fire and ice breaths.
en_grezzo: "He was originally three dragons but with the blessing of the elemental Itzparotl he became a deity. It does not have the ability to merge the conflicting attributes of fire and ice breaths."
it: In origine erano tre draghi, poi la protezione di Itzparotl degli elementi li ha fatti diventare un dio. Ma la stoffa per fondere in un soffio solo due elementi opposti come il fuoco e il ghiaccio non ce l'ha.

jp: 全ての魔族の頂点に立つ王。退屈症のため暇つぶし感覚でイルヴァにやってきている。強い魔力を持ち、深い絆が無ければ王の洗脳を跳ね除けるのは困難である。
jp_grezzo: "全ての魔族の頂点に立つ王。退屈症のため暇つぶし感覚でイルヴァにやってきている。強い魔力を持ち、深い絆が無ければ王の洗脳を跳ね除けるのは困難である。"
en: The king who stands at the top of all the demon races. They come to Irva to pass the time due to boredom. Without strong magic and a deep bond it would be difficult to repel the king's brainwashing.
en_grezzo: "The king who stands at the top of all the demon races. They come to Irva to pass the time due to boredom. Without strong magic and a deep bond it would be difficult to repel the king's brainwashing."
it: Il re che sta in cima a tutte le stirpi demoniache. Si annoia, e viene a Irva tanto per passare il tempo. Ha un potere magico forte: senza un legame profondo, scrollarsi di dosso il lavaggio del cervello del re è difficile.

jp: 下位の悪魔達を束ね治める領主。調子に乗った部下を一喝するのも仕事の一環。人の下につくのが嫌で全力で振り落としに掛かるらしい。
jp_grezzo: "下位の悪魔達を束ね治める領主。調子に乗った部下を一喝するのも仕事の一環。人の下につくのが嫌で全力で振り落としに掛かるらしい。"
en: A lord who unites and reigns over the lower demons. It's part of the job to cheer up a subordinate who's in a bad mood. They don't like to get under people so they try their best to shake them off.
en_grezzo: "A lord who unites and reigns over the lower demons. It's part of the job to cheer up a subordinate who's in a bad mood. They don't like to get under people so they try their best to shake them off."
it: Il signore che tiene insieme e governa i demoni di grado inferiore. Zittire con un urlo il sottoposto che si monta la testa fa parte del mestiere. Stare sotto qualcuno non gli va giù, e pare che faccia di tutto per scrollarselo di dosso.

jp: 堕落と原罪をこよなく愛する一般的な悪魔。他者を虐げることを好しとする彼らの戦闘能力は高い。肉弾戦でも魔法でも並の人間を上回るだろう。
jp_grezzo: "堕落と原罪をこよなく愛する一般的な悪魔。他者を虐げることを好しとする彼らの戦闘能力は高い。肉弾戦でも魔法でも並の人間を上回るだろう。"
en: A general devil who loves depravity and original sin immensely. Their fighting ability is high as they prefer to bully others. They would outperform the average human both in physical combat and in magic.
en_grezzo: "A general devil who loves depravity and original sin immensely. Their fighting ability is high as they prefer to bully others. They would outperform the average human both in physical combat and in magic."
it: Un demone qualunque, che ama alla follia la corruzione e il peccato d'origine. Poiché il suo gusto è calpestare gli altri, in combattimento vale molto: nel corpo a corpo e nella magia batte l'uomo comune.

jp: 深い洞窟内であろうと特殊電波により通信が可能。開発主任が直々に設計開発しておりやたら高性能。待機中は自動で戦闘行動を行い、データも収集する。
jp_grezzo: "深い洞窟内であろうと特殊電波により通信が可能。開発主任が直々に設計開発しておりやたら高性能。待機中は自動で戦闘行動を行い、データも収集する。"
en: Special radio waves can be used to communicate even in deep caves. It is designed and developed directly by the chief developer and is very high performance. While on standby it automatically performs combat actions and also collects data.
en_grezzo: "Special radio waves can be used to communicate even in deep caves. It is designed and developed directly by the chief developer and is very high performance. While on standby it automatically performs combat actions and also collects data."
it: Con le sue onde speciali riesce a comunicare perfino in fondo a una grotta. L'ha progettato e costruito di persona il capo dello sviluppo, e infatti rende una cosa esagerata. Quando è in attesa combatte da solo e intanto raccoglie dati.

jp: イルヴァで最も強い毒を持つ生物として有名。特定の巣を持たず集団で移動と襲撃を繰り返し生活する。獰猛で攻撃的であり、非常に危険。
jp_grezzo: "イルヴァで最も強い毒を持つ生物として有名。特定の巣を持たず集団で移動と襲撃を繰り返し生活する。獰猛で攻撃的であり、非常に危険。"
en: It is renowned as the most poisonous creature in Irva. They do not have a specific nest and live in groups repeatedly moving and attacking. They are fierce aggressive and very dangerous.
en_grezzo: "It is renowned as the most poisonous creature in Irva. They do not have a specific nest and live in groups repeatedly moving and attacking. They are fierce aggressive and very dangerous."
it: È famoso come la creatura dal veleno più forte di tutta Irva. Un nido suo non ce l'ha: vive in sciame e passa la vita a spostarsi e a piombare addosso a qualcuno. È feroce e aggressivo, e pericolosissimo.

jp: 神と星の加護を受けて変異したサソリ。一見何の変哲もない普通のサソリだが、その神経毒で動けなくなり殺される冒険者は後を断たない。
jp_grezzo: "神と星の加護を受けて変異したサソリ。一見何の変哲もない普通のサソリだが、その神経毒で動けなくなり殺される冒険者は後を断たない。"
en: A scorpion mutated with the blessings of the gods and stars. At first glance it appears to be an ordinary scorpion but there is no shortage of adventurers who are paralyzed and killed by its neurotoxin.
en_grezzo: "A scorpion mutated with the blessings of the gods and stars. At first glance it appears to be an ordinary scorpion but there is no shortage of adventurers who are paralyzed and killed by its neurotoxin."
it: Uno scorpione mutato sotto la protezione degli dei e delle stelle. A prima vista è uno scorpione come tanti, ma il suo veleno prende i nervi, e di avventurieri che restano immobili e ci lasciano la pelle non si finisce mai di contarne.

jp: 進化の過程で生まれた竜の亜種…のさらなる変異体。骨と筋肉の構造が特殊であり、片翼での攻撃でも異常な破壊力をたたき出す。
jp_grezzo: "進化の過程で生まれた竜の亜種…のさらなる変異体。骨と筋肉の構造が特殊であり、片翼での攻撃でも異常な破壊力をたたき出す。"
en: A further mutant of a subspecies of the dragon...born in the process of evolution. It has a special bone and muscle structure and even a single-winged attack can be unusually destructive.
en_grezzo: "A further mutant of a subspecies of the dragon...born in the process of evolution. It has a special bone and muscle structure and even a single-winged attack can be unusually destructive."
it: Una sottospecie di drago nata lungo il cammino dell'evoluzione, e poi mutata un'altra volta ancora. Ha ossa e muscoli fatti in modo particolare: perfino un colpo dato con una sola ala sprigiona una potenza distruttiva fuori dal comune.

jp: 混沌の力を操る黒きユニコーン。複数のモンスターが互いに取り込みあい融合した混沌の化身。偉いことには違いないのだが、混沌の神にはそこまで好かれていないようだ。
jp_grezzo: "混沌の力を操る黒きユニコーン。複数のモンスターが互いに取り込みあい融合した混沌の化身。偉いことには違いないのだが、混沌の神にはそこまで好かれていないようだ。"
en: A black unicorn that controls the power of chaos. An incarnation of chaos where multiple monsters have taken each other in and fused together. It must be a huge feat but the god of chaos doesn't seem to like it that much.
en_grezzo: "A black unicorn that controls the power of chaos. An incarnation of chaos where multiple monsters have taken each other in and fused together. It must be a huge feat but the god of chaos doesn't seem to like it that much."
it: Un unicorno nero che comanda la forza del caos. È l'incarnazione del caos, nata da più mostri che si sono divorati a vicenda e poi fusi insieme. Che sia una gran cosa non c'è dubbio, ma pare che al dio del caos non stia poi tanto simpatico.

jp: 混沌より生み出された眷属。混沌に呑まれ素材とされた者たちの意識が混ざり合っている。素材の中には混沌に立ち向かった勇士も混ざっているのだとか。
jp_grezzo: "混沌より生み出された眷属。混沌に呑まれ素材とされた者たちの意識が混ざり合っている。素材の中には混沌に立ち向かった勇士も混ざっているのだとか。"
en: The spawn of chaos. The consciousness of those who have been swallowed by chaos and made into material is blended. The material is mixed with the warriors who stood up to the chaos.
en_grezzo: "The spawn of chaos. The consciousness of those who have been swallowed by chaos and made into material is blended. The material is mixed with the warriors who stood up to the chaos."
it: Un figlio del caos, generato dal caos stesso. Dentro di lui si mescolano le coscienze di quelli che il caos ha inghiottito e usato come materia prima. E fra quella materia, dicono, ci sono anche i valorosi che gli tennero testa.

jp: 素早い動きで敵をかく乱しつつ多方向から攻撃を行う。兵士のサポート用に言語機能を標準搭載している。ちょろちょろついてくるのもあって、ペット感覚で扱う兵士も多い。
jp_grezzo: "素早い動きで敵をかく乱しつつ多方向から攻撃を行う。兵士のサポート用に言語機能を標準搭載している。ちょろちょろついてくるのもあって、ペット感覚で扱う兵士も多い。"
en: It attacks from multiple directions while disrupting the enemy with its quick movements. It comes standard with a language feature for supporting soldiers. There are also many soldiers who follow along and treat it as a pet.
en_grezzo: "It attacks from multiple directions while disrupting the enemy with its quick movements. It comes standard with a language feature for supporting soldiers. There are also many soldiers who follow along and treat it as a pet."
it: Si muove svelto, scompiglia il nemico e intanto lo attacca da più parti insieme. Di serie ha la funzione della lingua, per dare una mano ai soldati. E siccome trotterella dietro a tutti, molti soldati lo trattano come un animale di casa.

jp: 機械文明の遺産。レールガンの開発過程で生まれた雷撃砲を搭載している。基本は自走砲であるため最低限の装甲しか取り付けられていない。
jp_grezzo: "機械文明の遺産。レールガンの開発過程で生まれた雷撃砲を搭載している。基本は自走砲であるため最低限の装甲しか取り付けられていない。"
en: The legacy of mechanical civilization. It is equipped with a lightning cannon that was created during the development of the railgun. Since it is basically a self-propelled artillery it is equipped with only minimal armor.
en_grezzo: "The legacy of mechanical civilization. It is equipped with a lightning cannon that was created during the development of the railgun. Since it is basically a self-propelled artillery it is equipped with only minimal armor."
it: Un lascito della civiltà delle macchine. Monta il cannone a fulmini che venne fuori mentre si metteva a punto il cannone elettromagnetico. In sostanza è un pezzo semovente, e infatti di corazza ne ha il minimo indispensabile.

jp: ボコノン教を守るための存在。教徒がカラースの本来の目的から逸脱しそうになったとき、思考を打ち消し馬鹿げたものにしてしまう。
jp_grezzo: "ボコノン教を守るための存在。教徒がカラースの本来の目的から逸脱しそうになったとき、思考を打ち消し馬鹿げたものにしてしまう。"
en: They exist to defend Bokononism. When the congregation is about to deviate from the original purpose of Kalas they cancel out the thought and render it foolish.
en_grezzo: "They exist to defend Bokononism. When the congregation is about to deviate from the original purpose of Kalas they cancel out the thought and render it foolish."
it: Esiste per difendere il bokononismo. Quando un fedele sta per allontanarsi dallo scopo vero del karass, gli cancella il pensiero e glielo riduce a una sciocchezza.

jp: 3年もの間グウェンは心無い冒険者に捕まっていた。命からがら脱走に成功したが過酷な環境は少女を冷酷な戦士へと変えたのだった。
jp_grezzo: "3年もの間グウェンは心無い冒険者に捕まっていた。命からがら脱走に成功したが過酷な環境は少女を冷酷な戦士へと変えたのだった。"
en: For three years Gwen has been held captive by a heartless adventurer. She manages to escape with her life but the harsh environment has turned her into a ruthless warrior.
en_grezzo: "For three years Gwen has been held captive by a heartless adventurer. She manages to escape with her life but the harsh environment has turned her into a ruthless warrior."
it: Per tre anni interi Gwen è rimasta prigioniera di un avventuriero senza cuore. È riuscita a fuggire per il rotto della cuffia, ma quella vita durissima aveva ormai fatto della ragazzina una guerriera spietata.

jp: 主を守れなかった騎士の嘆きと絶望が呪いを生み、所持していた盾を変化させた。守るべきものを求めて彷徨う。しかし騎士の顔がへばりついているのが気味悪いので誰も護衛してほしがらない。
jp_grezzo: "主を守れなかった騎士の嘆きと絶望が呪いを生み、所持していた盾を変化させた。守るべきものを求めて彷徨う。しかし騎士の顔がへばりついているのが気味悪いので誰も護衛してほしがらない。"
en: The lament and despair of the knight's failure to protect the Lord gave rise to a curse that transformed the shield in his possession. It wanders in search of things to protect. However no one wants to be escorted because the knight's face is so creepy.
en_grezzo: "The lament and despair of the knight's failure to protect the Lord gave rise to a curse that transformed the shield in his possession. It wanders in search of things to protect. However no one wants to be escorted because the knight's face is so creepy."
it: Il lamento e la disperazione di un cavaliere che non era riuscito a proteggere il suo signore generarono una maledizione, e la maledizione trasformò lo scudo che teneva in mano. Vaga in cerca di qualcosa da proteggere; ma il viso del cavaliere ci è rimasto appiccicato sopra, e fa un effetto tale che nessuno lo vuole come scorta.

jp: 音もなく静かに獲物に忍び寄る。だがその図体のせいですぐに見つかってしまう。一応、霧を発生させるなどの工夫はするのだが…。
jp_grezzo: "音もなく静かに獲物に忍び寄る。だがその図体のせいですぐに見つかってしまう。一応、霧を発生させるなどの工夫はするのだが…。"
en: They creep up on their prey quietly and without sound. But because of its figure it was soon discovered. It's trying to create a fog but...
en_grezzo: "They creep up on their prey quietly and without sound. But because of its figure it was soon discovered. It's trying to create a fog but..."
it: Si avvicina alla preda in silenzio, senza fare il minimo rumore. Solo che, con quel corpaccione, la scoprono subito. Qualcosa per rimediare la fa, tipo tirare fuori la nebbia, ma insomma.

jp: 獲物めがけて長距離を跳躍する。200メートル以上も跳ぶものもいる。跳びついたあとはひたすら血を吸う。獲物に避けられても華麗に着地する技術を持つ。
jp_grezzo: "獲物めがけて長距離を跳躍する。200メートル以上も跳ぶものもいる。跳びついたあとはひたすら血を吸う。獲物に避けられても華麗に着地する技術を持つ。"
en: They leap long distances in pursuit of their prey some jumping over 200 meters. After jumping it sucks blood. It has the skill to land brilliantly even when its prey avoids it.
en_grezzo: "They leap long distances in pursuit of their prey some jumping over 200 meters. After jumping it sucks blood. It has the skill to land brilliantly even when its prey avoids it."
it: Spicca salti lunghissimi puntando alla preda, e ce n'è che supera i duecento metri. Una volta arrivata addosso, succhia sangue e basta. E anche quando la preda si scansa, sa atterrare con eleganza.

jp: ただ街を散歩しているだけなのに、なぜかとても嬉しそうにしている変な市民。まるで忍者のように俊敏なうえ、手裏剣を隠し持っている。
jp_grezzo: "ただ街を散歩しているだけなのに、なぜかとても嬉しそうにしている変な市民。まるで忍者のように俊敏なうえ、手裏剣を隠し持っている。"
en: It's a strange citizen who is just strolling around town but somehow seems very happy about it. In addition to being as agile as a ninja she has a hidden shuriken.
en_grezzo: "It's a strange citizen who is just strolling around town but somehow seems very happy about it. In addition to being as agile as a ninja she has a hidden shuriken."
it: Una cittadina strana: passeggia per la città e nient'altro, eppure ha un'aria felicissima. Oltre a essere svelta come una ninja, tiene nascosti addosso degli shuriken.

jp: 主人を守るため色々なものを犠牲にして魔法を会得した少女。いったいどんな苦痛を経験してきたのか、かなりひどい目に遭っても全然平気。
jp_grezzo: "主人を守るため色々なものを犠牲にして魔法を会得した少女。いったいどんな苦痛を経験してきたのか、かなりひどい目に遭っても全然平気。"
en: A girl who sacrificed many things to protect her master and mastered magic. She doesn't care at all what kind of pain she's been through even though she's been through some pretty bad things.
en_grezzo: "A girl who sacrificed many things to protect her master and mastered magic. She doesn't care at all what kind of pain she's been through even though she's been through some pretty bad things."
it: Una bambina che ha imparato la magia sacrificando ogni sorta di cosa, pur di proteggere il suo padrone. Chissà quali dolori ha passato: per quanto la concino male, a lei non fa né caldo né freddo.

jp: ものすごく駄目な姉。身だしなみやお洒落に全く興味がないどころか、寝癖を直す気すらない。最低限、下着さえつけていればジャージも着なくていいんじゃないかと最近思い始めている。
jp_grezzo: "ものすごく駄目な姉。身だしなみやお洒落に全く興味がないどころか、寝癖を直す気すらない。最低限、下着さえつけていればジャージも着なくていいんじゃないかと最近思い始めている。"
en: She's a very bad sister. Not only does she have no interest in grooming or dressing up she doesn't even bother to fix her sleeping habits. Recently she's started to think that she doesn't have to wear a jersey as long as she's wearing at least some underwear.
en_grezzo: "She's a very bad sister. Not only does she have no interest in grooming or dressing up she doesn't even bother to fix her sleeping habits. Recently she's started to think that she doesn't have to wear a jersey as long as she's wearing at least some underwear."
it: Una sorella maggiore buona a nulla, ma proprio a nulla. Non solo di curarsi e di vestirsi bene non le importa niente: non ha nemmeno voglia di aggiustarsi i capelli schiacciati dal cuscino. Di recente ha cominciato a pensare che, purché addosso ci sia almeno la biancheria, la tuta si potrebbe anche non metterla.

jp: 事故で主人と離ればなれになった犬。はぐれた先で変異を繰り返しながら外敵と戦い続けた結果、悪魔を退けるほどの力を身に着けた。
jp_grezzo: "事故で主人と離ればなれになった犬。はぐれた先で変異を繰り返しながら外敵と戦い続けた結果、悪魔を退けるほどの力を身に着けた。"
en: The dog was separated from her master by an accident. As a result of repeatedly mutating and fighting external enemies at the point where she got separated she became powerful enough to fend off demons.
en_grezzo: "The dog was separated from her master by an accident. As a result of repeatedly mutating and fighting external enemies at the point where she got separated she became powerful enough to fend off demons."
it: Una cagna che un incidente ha separato dal suo padrone. Là dove si era persa ha continuato a battersi contro i nemici, mutando una volta dopo l'altra, e alla fine si è ritrovata forte abbastanza da respingere un demone.

jp: 年を経た亀が変異した。元が亀とは思えないほど素早い。四肢は自らの意思で形状変化させることができる。悪ガキが近寄ってくるとプラズマを吐いて消し炭にする。
jp_grezzo: "年を経た亀が変異した。元が亀とは思えないほど素早い。四肢は自らの意思で形状変化させることができる。悪ガキが近寄ってくるとプラズマを吐いて消し炭にする。"
en: A tortoise that has mutated over the years. It is so fast that it is hard to believe that it was originally a tortoise. Its limbs can change shape at will. When a naughty kid comes close to it, it spits out plasma to obliterate the kid.
en_grezzo: "A tortoise that has mutated over the years. It is so fast that it is hard to believe that it was originally a tortoise. Its limbs can change shape at will. When a naughty kid comes close to it, it spits out plasma to obliterate the kid."
it: È una tartaruga che, con gli anni, è mutata. È così svelta che non si direbbe mai che tartaruga lo fosse davvero. Le zampe può cambiarle di forma quando le pare. E se le si avvicina un monello, gli sputa addosso il plasma e lo riduce in cenere.

jp: 九頭竜の子孫。その触手のような髪の毛を巧みに操る。何万年も海の底で暮らしていたため、地上の世界に興味深々。お弁当作りが趣味で、時々レイキに材料を買いに行ってもらっている。
jp_grezzo: "九頭竜の子孫。その触手のような髪の毛を巧みに操る。何万年も海の底で暮らしていたため、地上の世界に興味深々。お弁当作りが趣味で、時々レイキに材料を買いに行ってもらっている。"
en: Descendant of the nine-headed dragon. She is skilled in manipulating her tentacle-like hair. Having lived at the bottom of the sea for tens of thousands of years, she is deeply interested in the world above ground. She enjoys making lunch boxes and sometimes asks Leiki to go shopping for ingredients.
en_grezzo: "Descendant of the nine-headed dragon. She is skilled in manipulating her tentacle-like hair. Having lived at the bottom of the sea for tens of thousands of years, she is deeply interested in the world above ground. She enjoys making lunch boxes and sometimes asks Leiki to go shopping for ingredients."
it: Discende dal drago a nove teste. Maneggia con maestria quei suoi capelli che paiono tentacoli. Ha vissuto decine di migliaia di anni in fondo al mare, e il mondo di sopra la incuriosisce moltissimo. Il suo passatempo è preparare cestini da pranzo, e ogni tanto manda Leiki a comprare gli ingredienti.

jp: 元々は普通の魚だったものがミヅキの神気にあてられ変化した存在。今では彼女と彼女の祖先を崇拝する奉仕種族となっている。
jp_grezzo: "元々は普通の魚だったものがミヅキの神気にあてられ変化した存在。今では彼女と彼女の祖先を崇拝する奉仕種族となっている。"
en: Originally an normal fish, they were transformed by Mizuki's divine energy. They are now a service tribe that worships her and her ancestors.
en_grezzo: "Originally an normal fish, they were transformed by Mizuki's divine energy. They are now a service tribe that worships her and her ancestors."
it: Era un pesce come tanti, poi il soffio divino di Mizuki lo ha investito e lo ha cambiato. Adesso è una stirpe di servitori, che venera lei e i suoi antenati.

jp: 魔法国家に滅ぼされた国の戦士のなれの果て。次々と浴びせられる魔法にも怯まず、祖国のため最期まで戦い抜いた英雄。
jp_grezzo: "魔法国家に滅ぼされた国の戦士のなれの果て。次々と浴びせられる魔法にも怯まず、祖国のため最期まで戦い抜いた英雄。"
en: The last of the warriors of a kingdom destroyed by a magical kingdom. A hero who fought to the last for his country, undaunted by the magic that was hurled at him one after another.
en_grezzo: "The last of the warriors of a kingdom destroyed by a magical kingdom. A hero who fought to the last for his country, undaunted by the magic that was hurled at him one after another."
it: È quel che resta del guerriero di un regno che una nazione di maghi ha distrutto. Un eroe che non si perse d'animo sotto le magie che gli piovevano addosso una dopo l'altra, e si batté per la patria fino all'ultimo.

jp: 戦友を想う心が愛用の銃に宿り、持ち主の死後に魂と結合し精霊と化した。死してもなお、どこかの誰かのために戦い続ける存在。
jp_grezzo: "戦友を想う心が愛用の銃に宿り、持ち主の死後に魂と結合し精霊と化した。死してもなお、どこかの誰かのために戦い続ける存在。"
en: The love for one's comrades-in-arms is embodied in one's favourite gun, which combines with the soul after the owner's death and transforms into a spirit. Even in death, he continues to fight for someone somewhere.
en_grezzo: "The love for one's comrades-in-arms is embodied in one's favourite gun, which combines with the soul after the owner's death and transforms into a spirit. Even in death, he continues to fight for someone somewhere."
it: Il pensiero rivolto ai compagni d'arme si annidò nel fucile che il padrone aveva sempre con sé; poi il padrone morì, l'anima si unì all'arma e ne venne fuori uno spirito. Anche da morto continua a battersi per qualcuno, da qualche parte.

jp: イルヴァ土着の深海の住人。もとは別の神を崇めていたが、ミヅキの祖先の強い神気にあてられて改宗した。生まれた時はほぼ人の姿だが、歳をとるにつれて魚っぽくなっていく。
jp_grezzo: "イルヴァ土着の深海の住人。もとは別の神を崇めていたが、ミヅキの祖先の強い神気にあてられて改宗した。生まれた時はほぼ人の姿だが、歳をとるにつれて魚っぽくなっていく。"
en: Indigenous Irva inhabitants of the deep sea. Originally worshipped other deities, but converted due to the strong divine spirit of Mizuki's ancestors. At birth, they are almost human in appearance, but as they age they become more fish-like.
en_grezzo: "Indigenous Irva inhabitants of the deep sea. Originally worshipped other deities, but converted due to the strong divine spirit of Mizuki's ancestors. At birth, they are almost human in appearance, but as they age they become more fish-like."
it: Gente degli abissi, nativa di Irva. Un tempo venerava un altro dio, poi il soffio divino potente degli antenati di Mizuki la investì e la fece convertire. Alla nascita ha quasi la forma di un uomo, ma invecchiando somiglia sempre di più a un pesce.

jp: とても高貴な生まれ。物腰こそ柔らかだが、その性格は残虐で冷徹。使用人を戯れで皆殺しにしてしまい、もう少し頑丈な使用人を探している。来ている服こそ白いが、その実態は果てしなく黒い。
jp_grezzo: "とても高貴な生まれ。物腰こそ柔らかだが、その性格は残虐で冷徹。使用人を戯れで皆殺しにしてしまい、もう少し頑丈な使用人を探している。来ている服こそ白いが、その実態は果てしなく黒い。"
en: A young lady of very noble birth. She has a soft manner, but her nature is cruel and cold-hearted. She kills all her servants for fun and is looking for a sturdier servant. Her clothes are white, but in reality she is endlessly black.
en_grezzo: "A young lady of very noble birth. She has a soft manner, but her nature is cruel and cold-hearted. She kills all her servants for fun and is looking for a sturdier servant. Her clothes are white, but in reality she is endlessly black."
it: Di nascita nobilissima. I modi sono garbati, ma il carattere è crudele e gelido. Per gioco ha ammazzato tutta la servitù, e adesso cerca servitori un po' più robusti. Il vestito che porta è bianco; quello che c'è sotto è nero senza fondo.

jp: 現在の神々のまとめ役。三元素を司る。話が難しいうえに長いのでやや避けられ気味。本来は若々しい姿と他の神より強い力を持っているのだが、今はそのどちらも一部テスカトリポカのものとなっている。
jp_grezzo: "現在の神々のまとめ役。三元素を司る。話が難しいうえに長いのでやや避けられ気味。本来は若々しい姿と他の神より強い力を持っているのだが、今はそのどちらも一部テスカトリポカのものとなっている。"
en: Head of the current group of deities. Governs the three elements. He is somewhat avoided because of his difficult and long story. He originally has a youthful appearance and more power than the other gods, but both of these are now partly the properties of Tezcatlipoca.
en_grezzo: "Head of the current group of deities. Governs the three elements. He is somewhat avoided because of his difficult and long story. He originally has a youthful appearance and more power than the other gods, but both of these are now partly the properties of Tezcatlipoca."
it: È lui che tiene insieme gli dei di adesso, e governa i tre elementi. Parla difficile e parla lungo, e per questo lo evitano un po' tutti. Di suo avrebbe un aspetto giovane e una forza superiore a quella degli altri dei, ma oggi l'uno e l'altra sono in parte roba di Tezcatlipoca.

jp: 自らが支配する三元素の力を極限まで昇華させたイツパロトル。体が周囲の元素とリンクしたことによりマナの総量が膨れ上がっている。
jp_grezzo: "自らが支配する三元素の力を極限まで昇華させたイツパロトル。体が周囲の元素とリンクしたことによりマナの総量が膨れ上がっている。"
en: Itzparotl has sublimated the power of the three elements he controls to the utmost limit. The total amount of mana has swelled as a result of the body's link with the surrounding elements.
en_grezzo: "Itzparotl has sublimated the power of the three elements he controls to the utmost limit. The total amount of mana has swelled as a result of the body's link with the surrounding elements. "
it: È Itzparotl che ha portato all'estremo la forza dei tre elementi su cui comanda. Il corpo gli si è legato agli elementi che ha intorno, e per questo la sua mana è cresciuta a dismisura.
